heard: In the 1850s, Chicago was raised several feet to install a sewer system.  The world's first skyscraper, the 10-story home insurance building, was built in Chicago  in 1885, not New York.  The Great Chicago Fire was not started by Mrs. O'Leary's cow, and an even bigger fire  devastated Pishtego, Wisconsin on the same day.  Chicago was once the candy capital of the world, home to Tootsie Rolls, Cracker Jack,  and Juicy Fruit.
